title: Departmental Budgeting
cardCopy: A practical training course covering the fundamentals of departmental budgeting to keep department spend on track.
shortDescription: A practical training course covering the fundamentals of departmental budgeting to keep department spend on track.

sections.content: This session is primarily aimed at crew who are currently managing or controlling departmental budgets, but if you support with budgets in your role and want to build your knowledge for the future, you’re very welcome too.
The course will run across two days, and while you’re welcome to join either session, we’d recommend joining both if you can.

The sessions will be practical and conversational, with plenty of opportunity to bring your own questions, share experiences, and work through some of the budgeting challenges you’re coming up against. Led by industry expert Steve Clark-Hall, you can expect the sessions to cover:

• Getting the budget right from the start
• Knowing what you control
• Cost reporting
• Managing variance
• Problem-solving and building from scratch
Location: Virtual
Sign-up deadline: 8 October 12 pm (Noon).

This session has limited capacity, and we will allocate spots on a first-come, first-served basis. Please note that signing up does not confirm your place. We’ll send you an email to confirm your spot, so please keep an eye out for that.

title: Conflict Resolution Training
cardCopy: If conflict makes you feel awkward, or you need more confidence in tackling difficult conversations, then this is for you.
shortDescription: If conflict makes you feel awkward, or you need more confidence in tackling difficult conversations, then this is for you.

sections.content: Managing people often comes by default rather than by design in our sector. Suddenly, you find yourself managing others because you are good at your job. As with all relationships, navigating role demands, time constraints, personalities and communication challenges often leads to conflict. This session covers some tips, tricks and useful techniques for dealing with conflict, both for your personal development and in managing others. If conflict makes you feel awkward, or you need more confidence in tackling difficult conversations, then this is for you.

title: Career Mapping Session
cardCopy: This course is a hands-on session designed for entry-to-mid-level creatives to move away from reactive or sporadic career efforts towards a clear pathway to progression.
shortDescription: This course is a hands-on session designed for entry-to-mid-level creatives to move away from reactive or sporadic career efforts towards a clear pathway to progression.

sections.content: This course is a hands-on session designed for entry-to-mid-level creatives to move away from reactive or sporadic career efforts towards a clear pathway to progression. It reframes “what’s next?” conversations into intentional direction. Rather than relying on loose plans, participants will conduct a rigorous professional audit to identify their strengths and development areas. This will include a critical review of how they apply for work, how they position themselves, and the consistency of their outreach.

Through guided exercises and discussion, attendees will translate these findings into a personalised roadmap created during the session. This includes a breakdown of actions and deadlines, enabling them to move forward with clarity and confidence rather than guesswork.
This course is a workshop that requires active participation*. No pre-work is required, but a few days before, we will send through “Thinking points” from the trainer to consider before the session.
Outcome:

Participants will leave with a plan that is ready for immediate implementation. Designed as a dynamic professional tool, this career map can be continually refined and adapted, providing a reliable structure to maintain focus, track progress, and ensure long-term self-accountability, especially for freelancers.

This is a virtual session on Saturday, 17th October 2026, 11:00-15:00. If you are interested in taking part in the course, please register your interest below. This session has limited capacity, and we will allocate spots on a first-come, first-served basis. A confirmation of your spot and link to the session will be provided after signing up.
Deadline to Register: Tuesday 13th October 2026.
*You will be given writing tasks and time to think and map out your career.

title: Mental Health Awareness for All
cardCopy: The session will increase awareness and understanding of mental health and will help managers recognise the signs and offer support to people suffering from mental distress in the workplace and in the community.
shortDescription: The session will increase awareness and understanding of mental health and will help managers recognise the signs and offer support to people suffering from mental distress in the workplace and in the community.

sections.content: The challenges of filming schedules, post Covid-19 anxiety and fear, post-traumatic stress, demanding work schedules, and adapting to new filming practices have a large impact on mental health.

The session will increase awareness and understanding of mental health and will help to recognise the signs and offer support to people suffering from mental distress in the workplace and in the community.
This session will cover:
• What is mental health
• What influences mental health
• Recognising the signs
• Listening and supporting
• Tips for creating a supportive environment
• Q&A
Course Goals:
• Increased knowledge and empathy in relation to mental health and well-being
• Ability to identify the key signs and offer support
• Greater confidence in dealing with mental health issues
• Remove stigma and reduce discrimination, the signs
• Awareness and understanding of how to support and improve mental health in the workplace

This is a virtual session hosted by Solas Mind on Wednesday 30th September 2026, 10:00am-11:00am. If you are interested in taking part in the course, please register your interest below. A link to the session will be provided after signing up.
